csv_project_name: Consultant for Capital Improvement Plan - Batesburg-Leesvill
csv_scope_of_work: The Town of Batesburg-Leesville does not currently have an Impact Development Fee schedule or associated Capital Improvement Plan for General Fund departments (Police, Fire, Parks, Public Works). The Town has a CIP in place for water and sewer services. The primary purpose of the project is to complete research and assist in creation of an Impact Fee structure and Capital Improvements Plan for the Town of Batesburg-Leesville s general fund activities. The project must include all elements and requirements set forth in South Carolina state law.
csv_disciplines_requested: Civil Engineering, Cost Estimating, Land Use Planning, Planning/Master Planning, Urban Studies/Planning/Design

title: Consultant for Capital Improvement Plan - Batesburg-Leesville
short_description: Consulting services to prepare an impact fee structure and capital improvement plan.
project_scope: Preparation of an impact development fee structure and associated Capital Improvement Plan for the Town of Batesburg-Leesville's general fund departments, including Police, Fire, Parks, and Public Works, in compliance with South Carolina state law. The town already has a CIP for water and sewer services; this procurement focuses on research, planning, and documentation for general fund activities.
services: Consulting services including civil engineering, cost estimating, land use planning, planning/master planning, and urban studies/planning/design for development of an impact fee schedule and capital improvement plan.
relevance_explanation:
- Pure planning and consulting assignment without structural or building design.
- Focus is on impact fees and capital improvement planning, not on bridges, buildings, roofs, or special structures.
- Matches sbp exclusion criteria for pure urban/open space planning and planning-only services.
- No technical structural scope, spans, or construction design component indicated.
construction_cost_explanation: No construction project or construction budget is stated. The notice concerns preparation of an impact fee structure and capital improvement plan for municipal departments; no realistic construction cost estimate can be derived from the available information.
fee_explanation: No fee information is provided in the notice, and no realistic estimate for sbp can be derived because the scope is a general planning/consulting assignment rather than a defined structural design package.
references_qualifications: Disciplines requested: civil engineering, cost estimating, land use planning, planning/master planning, and urban studies/planning/design. No specific minimum reference projects or qualification thresholds are stated in the provided text.
contracting_authority: Town of Batesburg-Leesville, Lexington County, South Carolina, USA. Contact: Jason E. Hendrix. Phone: 803-413-7934. Email: jhendrix@batesburg-leesville.org. Website: https://www.batesburg-leesville.org/rfpsbid-opportunities
notes: Questions deadline: 08/17/2026 05:00 PM EDT. Solicitation documents available online. Although categorized here as Buildings to satisfy the required schema, the actual procurement is a municipal planning/fee study rather than a building or structural project.
